name: Agent Tool - WhatsApp Send
description: Sub-workflow for the AI agent: sends a WhatsApp message (free text or the approved booking-confirmation template) via Twilio and logs it to audit_log.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_type, actor_id, action, entity, entity_id, workflow, details) VALUES ('agent', 'staff_' || $1::text, 'whatsapp_send', 'customer_phone', $2::text, 'Agent Tool - WhatsApp Send', jsonb_build_object('mode', $3::text, 'status', $4::text, 'preview', left($5::text, 300), 'error', $6::text)) RETURNING $4::text AS status, $6::text AS error, $2::text AS phone, $7::text AS sid

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Prepare Message').first().json.staff, $('Prepare Message').first().json.phone, $('Prepare Message').first().json.mode, String($json.statusCode || ''), $('Prepare Message').first().json.preview, $('Prepare Message').first().json.bad ? 'invalid phone or empty message' : (($json.body && $json.body.message) || ''), ($json.body && $json.body.sid) || '' ] }}
